interaction_checks.limitation: The bounded full-text searches are not a universal prior-art or legal-priority search.
Exact-title co-occurrence is a bounded proxy; Semantic Scholar citation-reference data was unavailable.
No returned exact-title co-occurrence does not prove absence of co-citation.
The three supplied arXiv identity entries expose distinct author lists only for these versions.
OpenAlex full-text search coverage and indexing are incomplete.
These limitations constrain the bridge paper and do not establish universal failure of latent build-up.
HTTP 429 is provider unavailability and is not absence evidence.

known_limitations: Successful zero-result queries establish only not_observed_within_bounded_queries, not universal absence, noninteraction, novelty, or priority.
Semantic Scholar citation-reference checks were unavailable_from_service after HTTP 429 and cannot support an absence conclusion.
Semantic Scholar exact request and effective URLs are retained, but HTTP 429 made citation-reference results unavailable.
The bridge simulation cannot confirm that its latent build-up DGP exists in real markets.
The bridge real-data example uses one week of BTC/USDT and five labelled events and is not statistically reliable.
Source and response bytes are not retained in the repository; replay is limited to receipt metadata, exact extracts, and supplied frozen acquisition outside the packet.
